Using a cofactor expansion along the $2$nd column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -3 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 9 \\ -4 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ -5 & 2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{22}+0\cdot {C}_{32}+2\cdot {C}_{42} \\  & =2\cdot (-1)^{4+2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 9 \\ -4 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 9 \\ -4 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
